summary: Intermittent docker pull failures on internal CI agents causing branch build flakiness
description: Issue summary: Several branch builds on the internal CI pool intermittently fail during the `docker pull` step with transient 502/503 errors from the internal registry. Impact: ~10-15% of branch builds on the shared staging agent pool fail, causing developer churn and reruns. Not hitting production yet but reproducible on feature branches. Occurs since ~2026-03-18 after a routine registry config push. Expected: agents pull base images reliably. Actual: docker pull exits with non-EOF network errors and occasional TLS handshake failures.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger a branch CI build on staging using the shared agent pool (e.g., feature/* PR).
Observe the pipeline step that performs `docker pull` for base image (node:18-slim or our internal base).
Failures are intermittent; rerunning the same job often succeeds within 1-2 retries.

comments: 2026-03-20 09:14 - Ethan Brooks: Spotted this in multiple PR runs after the registry config was rolled on 3/18. Attaching logs from two failed jobs. Can we triage?
2026-03-20 10:02 - Priya Patel: I'm assigning to infra-ops. Initial hunch: proxy between agents and registry started returning 502 during burst. Collecting more agent-level tcpdump.
2026-03-21 11:45 - Miguel Santos: Noticed memory pressure on proxy pod during peak; OOM kills appear unrelated but correlate with spikes. Sharing dashboard link.
2026-03-22 08:30 - Priya Patel: Added rate-limiting on the proxy and increased replicas to 4 in staging; monitoring results overnight.
investigation_notes: TCP retransmits observed from agent-03 to registry on high-load windows.
Proxy logs show increased 502 responses aligning with increased pull concurrency after 04:00 UTC (scheduled nightly matrix jobs).
No auth failures in registry logs; upstream connectivity to artifact storage (S3 backend) shows transient 503 errors around the same timestamps.
resolution: Mitigation: increased proxy replicas and added a conservative client-side retry in the CI job manifest. Long-term: plan to decouple heavy nightly matrix builds to a dedicated pool and harden registry backend retry behavior. Work remains: track and validate for 72 hours, then schedule a follow-up change to move large dep pulls to a cache layer.
